resolution.note: Delivered by the PR that records D30 and narrows gate:local to the cheap preflight and isolation tests.

title: Make required CI the full Product gate (D30)
body:
Operator 2026-10-29 changed D11 for Product: required CI on the exact head is the full gate; locally only the cheap preflight (npm run preflight) and the systemd isolation tests run, under krn host-lock, before review. Record it as ADR 0014 D30.
Acceptance: D30 recorded; scripts/pr-preflight.mjs no longer requires krn/gate-local and instead requires the isolation status from the host-locked isolation run plus required CI; repository-workflow, lead-rules, README and spec/rules (KRN-07) agree; frozen observers RED on base and GREEN on head.
